cohort: 236 female patients who presented with acute abdominal pain at Albaag Hospital between 1st January 2017 to 1st January 2018 (196 with acute appendicitis and 40 with ruptured ovarian cyst)
finding: Poor appetite, fever and abnormal WCC predicted the diagnosis of acute appendicitis, while irregular menstrual cycle, nausea, abnormal urine examination and ultrasound findings suggestive of ruptured ovarian cyst predicted a ruptured ovarian cyst.
